name: Troxy
summary: A Grade II-listed art deco building that opened as a cinema in 1933, has since served as an opera school and as a bingo hall, and now hosts events.

music.notes: Live concerts and club nights, alongside MMA fights, immersive cinema, and seated talks, comedy nights and podcast recordings.

crowd: Troxy says everyone is welcome and that its staff are trained to make the experience inclusive.

accessibility.notes: Step-free through the front entrance and upper ground floor; the Circle is 43 steps up with no lift, and Front Stalls are 3 steps down. Hearing loop at the box office window. Accessible and free carer tickets; Hot Pink Wristband scheme; email accesstickets@troxy.co.uk.

cost.notes: Tickets are sold online only; there are no phone sales.

age_policy: Varies by event; shown on each event listing.

evidence.quote: Troxy first opened its doors in 1933 and ever since then our beautiful art deco building has played host to some of the capital’s most extraordinary events.
This characterful Grade II-listed building opened in 1933 as one of London's biggest and flashiest cinemas. It spent time as an opera school and a bingo hall
including MMA fights, immersive cinema, club nights and a huge range of live music concerts
For our talks, comedy nights, live podcasts and some gigs, we have seats available in both the Stalls on the ground floor and the Circle upstairs.
Everyone’s welcome at Troxy – our team will always do their best to accommodate you and make sure your visit is relaxed, welcoming and accessible.
In 2019 Troxy cemented its reputation as one of the flagship venues for LGBTQ+ led events.
All staff at the venue are highly trained to create a fully inclusive customer experience

Our building has step-free access via the front entrance, and throughout the upper section of the ground floor. Unfortunately, as we’re a grade II listed building, there’s no lift to the Circle seating upstairs, and this can only be accessed via 43 steps to our upper level.
Please note that Front Stalls tickets are not step-free accessible, as the lower ground floor area at the front of the auditorium is only accessible via 3 steps down from the upper ground floor.
We have a hearing loop system in place at our box office window.
Our accessible toilet is located in the left-hand side of the foyer through the main entrance, and is accessible via Radar key.
The accessible ticket policy limits one free carer ticket to each accessible ticket purchased.
You can contact our accessibility team directly at accesstickets@troxy.co.uk
Hot Pink Wristbands are a discreet and simple way to indicate non-visible disabilities/conditions
Unfortunately, we don’t sell tickets over the phone, as we’re a digital only venue.
Age restrictions will vary for each event and will be listed on our website and on ticketing sites when you purchase tickets
as the capacity increases from 3,100 to 3,600
